targets.queryText: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'guardian' THEN input ELSE 0 END) / MAX(SUM(input), 1) AS value FROM turn_usage WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(input) * 1.0 / MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT thread_id || ':' || turn_id), 1) AS value FROM turn_usage WHERE kind = 'guardian' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(input) * 1.0 / MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT thread_id || ':' || turn_id), 1) AS value FROM turn_usage WHERE kind = 'guardian' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')

targets.queryText: SELECT cmd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM calls WHERE escalated = 1 AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY cmd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT cmd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM calls WHERE escalated = 1 AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY cmd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') AS model, SUM(input) AS input, SUM(output) AS output FROM turn_usage WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
